reviews.title: Great Project Planning and easy Project Management Tool.
reviews.pros: The cost estimation, scheduling and easy project collaboration this product is perfect. Reliable on activities tracking and resources management and the ability to create reports the tool is amazing.
reviews.cons: No issues found and the first learning is easy and no much technical help required.
reviews.overall: Useful project document management and the contract data management to file transfer this platform is fantastic and easy data analytics creation product.

reviews.title: Great Project Management Software
reviews.pros: Everything you need is all in one place and can be distributed from within the program. The plans as uploaded and the newest set/pages are always what you see first which is great whenever there are any changes.
reviews.cons: Nothing that I can think of. I have not used any of the financial features.
reviews.overall: Procore is the best project management software i have used to date. I highly recommend it to any company looking for a new project management/field program.
